title: 第014章 隘口藏奸施暗计，妒兄设伏害琴姬
content_zh:
王磊愣在原地，手里的剑“哐当”一声掉在地上。

    刚才还凶神恶煞要吃人的夜哭怪，咋就突然间变成了一个会撒娇的软毛球？

    最离谱的竟然还认识蔡师妹？

    蔡文姬却是一眼就认出了对方，随即笑着摸了摸它柔软的绒毛：“你是梦奇吧？”

    “嗯嗯！我是梦奇！”梦奇用力点头，骄傲地挺起小胸脯。

    “我是入梦之灵！我肚子里有好大一个空间，能装好多好多东西！我还能吞坏人的噩梦和坏气，变成好吃的梦元给你吃！”

    说着，它张开小嘴，吐出一团纯净的白色光团，递到蔡文姬嘴边。

    蔡文姬笑着吸收了这团梦元，瞬间感觉之前收拾散修消耗的灵气全部恢复，甚至比之前更加充沛。

    “对了梦奇，”她忽然想起什么，连忙问道，“之前失踪的两个小孩子呢？你有没有伤害他们？”

    梦奇立刻摇头，不好意思地挠挠头：“没有没有啦！我把他们藏在我肚子里了，怕他们被那三个坏人欺负！我只吃了他们的噩梦，没有碰他们！”

    说着，它张开小嘴轻轻一吐，两个睡得正香的小男孩就稳稳落在了地上。

    王磊连忙上前检查，发现两个孩子呼吸平稳，脸色红润，果然毫发无伤。

    村民们听到动静，纷纷打开门窗跑出来。

    看到失踪的孩子安然无恙。

    又看到那个可怕的夜哭怪，居然变成了软乎乎的白色小毛球，惊讶之余，全都喜极而泣。

    简单解释清楚梦奇被魔气入侵的苦衷，并且安抚村民后，蔡文姬与王磊转身离开落云村，赶往下一处受害的清溪村。

    梦奇变成巴掌大小，稳稳窝在蔡文姬的肩头，嘴里叼着一根村民送的糖葫芦，吃得腮帮子鼓鼓的。

    “文姬文姬，清溪村有好吃的吗？”

    “有坏人吗？有坏人我就吞掉他的噩梦！”

    “你的行囊和换洗衣物都给我装吧！我肚子里可大了，还能保鲜呢！”

    它叽叽喳喳说个不停，给原本沉闷的山路增添了不少乐趣。

    蔡文姬笑着把背上的布包递过去，梦奇张开小嘴“啊呜”一口就吞了下去，拍了拍圆滚滚的小肚子：“搞定！还有什么要装的吗？”
content_en:
Wang Lei froze on the spot, and the sword in his hand fell to the ground with a clang.

    Why did the Night Crying Monster, who was so ferocious and wanted to eat people just now, suddenly turn into a coquettish soft fur ball?

    The most outrageous thing is that he actually knows Junior Sister Cai?

    Cai Wenji recognized the other person at a glance, then smiled and touched its soft down: "Are you Mengqi?"

    "Yeah! I'm Mengqi!" Mengqi nodded vigorously and proudly puffed up his chest.

    "I am a dream spirit! There is a big space in my belly that can hold a lot of things! I can also swallow bad people's nightmares and bad energy and turn them into delicious dream essences for you to eat!"

    As it spoke, it opened its small mouth, spit out a ball of pure white light, and handed it to Cai Wenji's mouth.

    Cai Wenji smiled as she absorbed the ball of dream energy, and instantly felt that all the spiritual energy she had consumed in cleaning up the casual cultivators had been restored, even more abundant than before.

    "By the way, Mengqi," she suddenly remembered something and asked quickly, "Where are the two children who disappeared before? Did you hurt them?"

    Meng Qi immediately shook his head and scratched his head in embarrassment: "No, no! I hid them in my belly because I was afraid that they would be bullied by those three bad guys! I only ate their nightmares and didn't touch them!"

    After saying that, it opened its little mouth and spat out gently, and the two little boys, who were sleeping soundly, landed firmly on the ground.

    Wang Lei quickly stepped forward to check and found that the two children were breathing steadily and had rosy faces. Sure enough, they were unharmed.

    When the villagers heard the noise, they opened their doors and windows and ran out.

    Seeing the missing child safe and sound.

    Then they saw that the scary night cry monster turned into a soft white fur ball. They were so surprised that they all cried with joy.

    After briefly explaining the reason why Meng Qi was invaded by demonic energy and appeasing the villagers, Cai Wenji and Wang Lei turned around and left Luoyun Village and rushed to Qingxi Village, the next victim.

    Mengqi became the size of a palm, resting firmly on Cai Wenji's shoulder, holding a candied haws given by a villager in his mouth, eating it until his cheeks were bulging.

    "Wenji Wenji, is there anything delicious in Qingxi Village?"

    "Are there any bad people? If there are bad people, I will swallow their nightmares!"

    "Pack your luggage and change of clothes for me! I'm so big in my belly, I can still keep it fresh!"

    It chattered non-stop, adding a lot of fun to the otherwise boring mountain road.

    Cai Wenji smiled and handed over the cloth bag on her back. Mengqi opened her mouth and swallowed it in one mouthful, patting her round belly: "Done! Is there anything else to pack?"
title_en: Chapter 014: A traitor is hiding in the pass and plotting, and the jealous brother sets an ambush to harm Qin Ji
